title: TMEGB03: residential electricity prices in euro per kWh, by year, semester, pricing basis and Eurostat household electricity consumption band (DA to DE)
used_for: The INDEPENDENT level check on D27's unit rates. Band DC is 2,500 to 5,000 kWh a year, which is where an Irish domestic meter sits, and the series is published per semester, so the 2022 half-year prices bracket the supplier's own 1 May 2022 schedule. Published by the CSO and not by the supplier whose rates are on the card, which is what makes it a check rather than a restatement. Exposure `none`.
